## Second Verse
<!--Put the first five lines of a poem by Robert Frost here!-->

Two roads diverged in a yellow wood,  
And sorry I could not travel both  
And be one traveler, long I stood  
And looked down one as far as I could  
To where it bent in the undergrowth;

## Last Verse
<!--Put a short poem you created using chatGPT of 20 to 30 lines,here!-->

Beneath the moon, the quiet stars appear,  
Whispering dreams that only hearts can hear.  
The night unfolds its blanket, soft and wide,  
While hopes and wishes gently drift inside.  

A lonely road winds underneath the sky,  
Yet every step reminds us we can try.  
The winds may change, the clouds may block the sun,  
But every ending means a new begun.  

A little light can brighten darkest days,  
A single spark can set the soul ablaze.  
And even when the world feels cold and gray,  
Tomorrow waits beyond the edge of today.  

So hold your dreams as tightly as you can,  
And trust the journey, though you lack a plan.  
The stars were never meant to light the ground,  
They shine to show that beauty can be found.  

Let courage grow where fear once used to stay,  
Let kindness guide the choices made each day.  
For life is more than roads we leave behind,  
It's all the little moments that we find.  

And when you reach the place you've dreamed to see,  
You'll find the greatest journey was to be.  
So walk ahead, beneath the endless blue,  
And let the world discover all of you.
